shortDescription: Calculates free group ids between the from and to options

options.name: from
options.description: The start value for the range of group ids to return.

options.name: groups
options.description: A list of UNIX group names to use the return free_group_ids to create.

options.name: to
options.description: The start value for the range of group ids to return.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of UNIX user names to use the return free_user_ids to create.
